population: US commercial claims, IUD users (external plausibility check only, NOT population-matched)
cost_source: PMC10776262 (Table 2): 4.5 surgical-management-of-perforation events per 100 enrolled IUD users over a 5-year period; mean cost $31 per enrolled individual over the same period and denominator. $31 / 0.045 = $688.89/event.
notes: NOT used as a base-case or wired value -- explicitly retained only as an external plausibility check, per the user's own instruction. Population and perforation mechanism differ from D&C (IUD-insertion-related perforation vs. instrument-related curettage perforation); this figure is far below the CMS-priced diagnostic-laparoscopy total above ($6,492.30), which is informative on its own: it suggests the claims-based 'surgical management' category in that study likely includes many lower-intensity managements (e.g., office-based IUD retrieval) rather than uniformly representing OR-based laparoscopy/laparotomy, reinforcing why it should not be substituted for the D&C-specific, management-state-weighted estimate above.
